ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why anyone claiming an 80% win rate is lying or selling something
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text:
Someone just told you they hit 80% of their picks.

Run.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text:
The misconception: a higher win rate means a better bettor.

Most people assume 70%, 80%, 90% is just what the pros do. It isn't.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text:
The honest number is 53 to 58 percent.

That is what sharp professional bettors hit over large samples. The books set lines specifically to make 52.4% the breakeven. Nobody clears 65% at scale. Nobody.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text:
The math:
100 bets at -110 odds.
Breakeven = 52.4 wins.
At 80% claimed: 80 wins. That's a +$2,700 profit per $100 unit.

If that were real, the books would ban the account in a week. They don't, because it isn't.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text:
We're 266-224 on the year. 54.3% win rate. +45.6u net.

That's what real edge looks like over 51 days. Boring, consistent, and provably real.
